question: Corrected fault-loop and protection assessment: distribute the stored bus energy through the ACTUAL loop and name a protection element that can act on it.
focus: COMPLETION CRITERIA (this attempt is not complete until all are met). 1) ASSESS THE PROPOSED ACTIVE BRIDGE: its own fault path, its controller's behaviour under fault (TEA2209T), and its MOSFETs' survival at the fault current and duration. The 350 A / 510 A2s figures are the GBJ PASSIVE bridge's and cannot qualify it. 2) SEPARATE the two fault classes explicitly: line-fed switch shorts (source-fed, ms timescale) and internal capacitor discharge (2240.47 uF, 179.24 J stored, ~100 us timescale). They have different limiting impedances, energies and interrupting elements. 3) PROTECTION ARRANGEMENT: identify an arrangement that ACTUALLY INTERRUPTS each relevant path, and EXPLICITLY LIST THE FAULTS IT CANNOT INTERRUPT. Gate shutdown cannot interrupt an already-shorted transistor; a crowbar needs a coordinated interruption or energy-handling path; the existing shunt U12 cannot sense the internal loop. Name what acts, on which loop, and why it can. 4) UNRESOLVED BY DESIGN: keep peak current and energy distribution NULL wherever the model lacks defensible inputs (the AC source/line impedance is not established). Do not fill them. 5) RETURN a concrete circuit recommendation and the remaining evidence requirements. 6) LOOP CONSISTENCY IS GATED: any current or energy assignment must pass `python3 zapote/tools/check_fault_loop.py --netlist <netlist> --loop-nets PFC_BUS_PLUS_390V,PFC_BUS_MINUS,a1 --assignments <assignments.json>` and the checker output retained. The checker is a NECESSARY connectivity check only - it does not prove a conductive path, device state, direction or distribution. Do not present a passing check as physical evidence. ARC NOTE: F1 (Schurter 0034.3129) has 1,638 A2s typical melting I2t at 10x rated and 160 A breaking capacity at 250 VAC; coordination needs total clearing behaviour at matching test conditions, not unmatched I2t figures.
stop_rule: Do not assign current to an element outside the loop; do not treat OCP, a crowbar and a fuse as interchangeable; do not qualify the active bridge with the passive bridge's ratings; do not fill an unresolved peak current or energy distribution. A conclusion that no adequate protection exists on the current board is valid and useful.
